text:
emily: Quick convo: product wants a 'credit dampening' option for cache savings so the per-route cost dashboard doesn't ping-pong when small traffic bursts flip prefetch behaviour. They want an API/telemetry + console plan. TL;DR: add telemetry flags + a UX to show "provisional" credits and an opt-in tenant toggle.

kevin: Proposed telemetry additions: `crediting_policy` (enum: legacy|dampen|amortize), `pending_credit_usd` (float), `credit_decay_half_life_s` (int), `dampening_state` (none|cooldown|active). This lets infra decide to slowly apply/remove credits instead of instant add/remove.

ryan: From infra: dampening sounds like we'll need to keep short-lived state in the router (per-route) and emit events when state transitions occur. That means more cardinality in telemetry. We should cap the distinct states to keep storage sane.

neha: For the console, UX rules: show a separate column "provisional_savings" with greyed amount and hover text "Provisional: applying over Nm half-life to avoid invoice churn". Add a compact timeline sparkline per-route with markers when dampening started/stopped.

kevin: Example telemetry event we'll emit (single-line JSON in the text field): {"route_id":"r_77","model":"m-70b-q4","policy":"dampen","prefetch_hit_rate":0.62,"pending_credit_usd":"3.45","credit_decay_half_life_s":"1800","dampening_state":"cooldown"}

emily: Important product constraint: pending/provisional amounts must never be included in authoritative invoices unless tenant explicitly enables. Default: internal-only. If tenant opts in we show a big banner that says "Provisional savings may change until stabilised" and a timestamp when evaluation started.

ryan: Rollout: canary-bot suggests a 3-stage rollout: 1) internal telemetry-only for all routes, 2) enable UI for internal users and opt-in customers (5% tenants), 3) enable per-tenant default opt-in for new trials if product likes results. Canary-bot: canary flag created ff/credit-dampen-176999 by canary-bot at 1769999000 :white_check_mark:

kevin: Analytics/backfill: we can backfill `dampening_state` by recomputing hit-rate walks over historical windows but mark backfilled records with `source:backfill` to avoid confusing downstream. We'll add `credit_origin` tag (live|backfill|estimated).

neha: Dashboard SQL sketch for amortized unit cost (used in mock): ```sql
WITH per_window AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, route_id, model, window_ts,
    SUM(tokens_generated) as tokens, SUM(allocated_cost_usd) as allocated_usd,
    SUM(pending_credit_usd) as pending_usd
  FROM prefetch_cost_windows
  WHERE window_ts > now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY tenant_id, route_id, model, window_ts
),
amort AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(pending_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id, route_id, model ORDER BY window_ts ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as amortized_pending
  FROM per_window
)
SELECT tenant_id, route_id, model,
  SUM(allocated_usd) as total_allocated,
  SUM(amortized_pending) as total_amortized_pending,
  (SUM(allocated_usd) - SUM(amortized_pending)) / NULLIF(SUM(tokens),0) as effective_unit_cost_usd
FROM amort
GROUP BY tenant_id, route_id, model;
```

sara: UX detail: we'll add a console toggle in the cost view header: [Include provisional savings in totals] with small tooltip linking to docs. Also add an "apply to invoice" checkbox for tenant admins who opt-in (must be persisted per-account and only enabled after 24h of stable state).

kevin: API contract note: keep legacy behaviour if `crediting_policy` absent. New policy values are opt-in. We'll version the telemetry schema (v2) and publish migration notes.

emily: Security/compliance: finance asked that any route-level provisional amounts never leak to billing exports unless the tenant has explicitly toggled. Add server-side enforcement.

ryan: Metrics/alerts: add a dashboard that tracks proportion of credits in state `cooldown` vs `active`. If too many credits stuck in `cooldown` > 30% for a day that suggests threshold tuning needed.

neha: I'll produce the console mocks with the pending column + sparkline markers and upload to #design by EOD Friday.

emily: Owners: kevin=telemetry + schema + backfill, ryan=router infra + gating, neha=console + SQL + mocks, sara=dashboard wiring + toggle UX. Sync Mon 10am after initial PRs. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
